panels.description: REPLAY when any fl_checks_total{source="replay"} was recorded in the last 5 minutes. Replayed or synthetic data is never presented as live. Counters without a source label (LLM, sandbox, security) include replayed traffic while the banner says REPLAY. Thresholds: green = LIVE only, orange = replayed data present (a label, not a fault). No data: no check was recorded at all; the panel then reads LIVE.

panels.title: Where these numbers come from | مصدر الأرقام

options.content: Every tile reads the eval gauges (metric family `eval`), served by the **evals-exporter** from the published artifacts in `evals/results/published/` (read-only). Tiles show the **latest** artifact per source: value, bootstrap 95% CI, n and provenance (real or synthetic). No value is typed here; if an artifact is missing the tile says so. Offline scores are not live accuracy.

panels.title: Latest artifacts | آخر الأدلة المنشورة
Artifacts | الملفات المنشورة
panels.description: Every published artifact: source, name, date, git sha, provenance and dataset hash prefix. Sources: main (T1 + arbiter), fp_regress (held-out real sites), redteam, message_text, dspy, fits. Thresholds: none: metadata. No data: the evals-exporter is not running (obs profile) or evals/results/published has no matching artifact.

panels.title: Real vs synthetic | حقيقي مقابل اصطناعي
Real vs synthetic | حقيقي مقابل اصطناعي

options.content: Left of each pair is **REAL** (frozen manifest items, scored offline by the shipped model); right is **SYNTHETIC** (invented Falcon Demo Bank URL fixtures and synthetic messages). Source: the latest `synthetic_split` artifact. The two are never averaged together. Synthetic rows measure plumbing, not accuracy on real scams.

panels.title: [REAL] Recall, warning | الاستدعاء
panels.description: Share of phishing items that received a warning (suspicious or dangerous). Real manifest items, test split. Provenance: REAL. Colour = provenance: blue real, purple synthetic, grey fixture (Falcon Demo Bank corpus), gold mixed. The legend always ends with the provenance label of the artifact. Legend under the value = source artifact name and provenance label; CI = 95% interval stored in the artifact (blank when the artifact stores none). n = items evaluated. Thresholds: real: green >= 90%, red below (docs/EVALS.md target); synthetic: none, fixtures are not a target set. No data: the evals-exporter is not running (obs profile) or evals/results/published has no matching artifact.
